purpose: Strategic-only payoff bundles for already-normalized transport actions. A bundle compares distinct useful capabilities; it does not add factual requirements, link its actions in sequence, or choose a route.

bundles.name: Early transport network
bundles.score_policy: Each distinct durable capability may contribute at most its own bounded contextual bonus while the network is incomplete. Replenishable item options are displayed but receive no bundle bonus.

components.name: Spirit trees
components.payoff_note: Adds one durable early travel capability that can support later objectives without making them route dependencies.
components.usage_caveat: Only the existing evaluator action determines its factual access requirements.

components.name: Gnome gliders
components.payoff_note: Adds a separate durable travel capability; it is not treated as an extension required by spirit trees.
components.usage_caveat: Military-glider extensions and later content remain outside this early bundle.

components.name: Fairy rings
components.payoff_note: Adds a broad durable travel capability once the existing action's permission and use conditions are met.
components.usage_caveat: The bundle never assumes a staff, elite-diary exemption, or any separate access condition.

components.name: Ardougne cloak
components.payoff_note: Adds a durable claimable convenience capability when its separately confirmed diary state supports it.
components.usage_caveat: The bundle does not infer a diary tier, cloak possession, or later-tier teleports.

components.name: Chronicle
components.payoff_note: Shows a modest, account-state-dependent travel option alongside durable unlocks without equating it to one.
components.usage_caveat: A usable teleport still requires an explicitly recorded card; cards, charges, and replacement funds are never assumed.

components.name: Games necklace
components.payoff_note: Shows a currently held charged-jewellery option separately from durable network access.
components.usage_caveat: No jewellery, charges, gems, runes, or replacement path is inferred from bundle membership.

components.name: Ring of dueling
components.payoff_note: Shows a currently held charged-jewellery option separately from durable network access.
components.usage_caveat: No jewellery, charges, gems, runes, or replacement path is inferred from bundle membership.
